purpose: Say that feeling or intention is put into an action or object.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
express feelings speak politely show respect
I wrote a letter filled with gratitude.
We planted a tree with a wish in our hearts.
I prepared the meal with care.
restrictions: Common with 感謝, 心, 愛情, and 願い.
mistake: Do not use it simply for physically putting an object into a container.

segments.role: Say that feeling or intention is put into an action or object. Feeling noun + を込めて
